name: Ikenai Hokenshitsu
original_name: い・け・な・い保健室
source:
Main character is a student who frequents health room as of late. The reason is the rumor he overhears about health room nurse giving secret love consultations.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名学生，近来常常光顾保健室。原因在于，他偶然听到一则传闻：保健室老师会在这里秘密替学生解答恋爱烦恼。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
